elena: Hi everyone — quick heads-up about tomorrow's company all-hands at 10:00 PT. Agenda below, recording will be posted right after. Please drop any Qs in this thread or add them to the shared doc: <https://docs.redwood.example/allhands-may> :calendar: 

Agenda:
- 10:00 — Opening & three key metrics (Elena)
- 10:10 — Product launch callouts: Redwood Optimize + Dedicated scaling (Priya)
- 10:25 — Policy update: data retention defaults + Private deployment checklist (Security)
- 10:40 — Live demo: autoscale tuning and cost dashboard (Sam)
- 10:50 — Customer spotlight + win share (CS)
- 11:00 — Q&A (15m)

Please add any items you want covered in Q&A, and if you'd like 2-mins on stage for a demo, reply here. Thanks :wave:

sam: I can do the autoscale demo — will post slides in the doc. Need a 2-min mic check beforehand.

raj: Quick question — will the policy update include the new KMS integration rollout timeline?

elena: Yes — Security will cover rollout windows and migration guidance. If you have specific compliance questions, flag them here or in the doc.

lisa: How long should demos be? Trying to time my demo to not exceed 2m.

elena: Keep demos to 2m max. If you need more, we can slot into next week's team showcase.

calendar-bot: Reminder created: Company All-Hands — May 7, 10:00 PT. Guests: all@redwood.example 

mike: Posting a pre-read for the launch callouts: <https://internal.redwood/launch/optimize-brief> — TL;DR: model caching + autoscale improvements reduce median token cost by ~18% on our benchmark.

raj: Adding a question — any expected change to default batch size for Hosted API? Ops/Runtime?

sam: Ops/Runtime — we recommend conservative batch sizes for low-latency routes; will include suggested config table in slides.

elena: Thanks team. After the call I'll post the recording and 1-paragraph takeaways here, plus action items. If any product/infra folks want follow-ups, ping me or drop notes in the doc. :memo:

-- (post-call update, same thread) --

mike: Recording posted: <https://meetings.redwood.example/recordings/2450123801> (starts at 0:00, skip to 10:10 for product launch callouts).

elena: TL;DR takeaways:
- Launch: Redwood Optimize GA next week; customers on Dedicated get early access.
- Policy: Default data retention reduced to 30 days for hosted logs; Private deployments retain current defaults.
- Ops: Autoscale tuning guide and recommended batch-size table added to the product doc.

Action items:
- Priya: coordinate GA rollout comms (due: 2450123900)
- Security: publish KMS migration FAQ (due: 2450123960)
- Sam: upload demo artifacts + perf table (done)
- CS: follow up with the customer in the spotlight for testimonial permissions (due: 2450124000)

raj: Thanks — can Security add a migration checklist for Dedicated customers specifically?

elena: Noted, Raj — Security will add Dedicated checklist as a separate section in the FAQ.

lisa: Appreciated the concise format, especially the action list. :thumbsup:

mike: If anyone wants the raw benchmark CSVs, ping me and I'll share.

elena: Closing this thread — final notes and links will live in the doc. If you need to escalate any action, DM me or the exec channel. :lock:
